title: Review: introducing yourself
why: Review of unit 4: pronouns, gender, nationalities, numbers, the article and adjectives, all brought together in a real encounter in Tel Aviv. After this lesson, you can introduce yourself and ask the same questions; unit 5 then opens up the present tense of verbs.

{"lessons": ["

Introducing yourself in a few sentences

With this unit, you can already introduce yourself fully, without a single conjugated verb (apart from the expression גָּר / גָּרָה). Pick the column that fits you:

A man saysA woman saysMeaning
אֲנִי מַרְק.אֲנִי לֵאָה.I'm Marc. / I'm Léa.
אֲנִי צָרְפָתִי, מִפָּרִיז.אֲנִי צָרְפָתִיָּה, מִפָּרִיז.I'm French, from Paris.
אֲנִי גָּר בְּתֵל אָבִיב.אֲנִי גָּרָה בְּתֵל אָבִיב.I live in Tel Aviv.
אֲנִי מְהַנְדֵּס.אֲנִי מְהַנְדֶּסֶת.I'm an engineer.

And to talk about the city: תֵּל אָבִיב עִיר יָפָה (Tel Aviv is a beautiful city), הָעִיר יְקָרָה (the city is expensive).

The four reflexes of this unit: no verb \"to be\"; no word for \"a / an\"; the adjective after the noun; and everything agrees with the person, including when you're the one speaking.

", "

Asking the questions

To a manTo a womanMeaning
מִי אַתָּה?מִי אַתְּ?Who are you?
מֵאֵיפֹה אַתָּה?מֵאֵיפֹה אַתְּ?Where are you from?
אֵיפֹה אַתָּה גָּר?אֵיפֹה אַתְּ גָּרָה?Where do you live?
בֶּן כַּמָּה אַתָּה?בַּת כַּמָּה אַתְּ?How old are you?
מָה הַמִּסְפָּר שֶׁלְּךָ?מָה הַמִּסְפָּר שֶׁלָּךְ?What's your number?

For a group, remember the plural pronouns: מֵאֵיפֹה אַתֶּם? (where are you all from?), answer אֲנַחְנוּ מִקָּנָדָה (we're from Canada).

", "

The traps of this unit

  • מִ becomes מֵ before א ה ח ע ר: מֵחֵיפָה, מֵרוֹמָא, but מִתֵּל אָבִיב.
  • בְּ for the place where you are, מִ for the place you come from: אֲנִי מִפָּרִיז, אֲבָל אֲנִי גָּר בְּתֵל אָבִיב.
  • A mixed group takes the masculine: הֵם, אַתֶּם, חֲבֵרִים.
  • For counting and giving a number: אַחַת, שְׁתַּיִם, שָׁלוֹשׁ… For age: בֶּן or בַּת + number.
  • הַבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל (the big house) is not a sentence; הַבַּיִת גָּדוֹל (the house is big) is one.
  • עִיר and דִּירָה are feminine: עִיר יָפָה, דִּירָה קְטַנָּה.
